check_events.outcome: At the group level only, take r:S3→S3 to be sign followed by the homomorphic section C2→S3 sending the nontrivial class to (12). The commutator subgroup is A3: sign kills commutators, and a commutator of transpositions is a nontrivial 3-cycle generating A3. Thus S3^ab=C2. Both id and r induce id on C2, but their image orders are 6 and 2, so they cannot be conjugate by a target element. This illustrates loss of information under abelianization only; it does not verify the geometric reconstruction claims.
